subject.title: fix: reject invalid channel account selections

question: Should upgraded callers that explicitly select an invalid, disabled, missing, conflicting, or channel-mismatched account fail visibly instead of falling back to another configured account?
rationale: The code and proof support both the implementation and the preserved omitted-account path, but choosing whether explicit invalid input may borrow a different configured identity is a user-facing delivery and compatibility contract that cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt strict explicit routing
options.body: Merge after refresh, treating every explicit account selection as authoritative and returning an error when it cannot resolve to an enabled account.

options.title: Preserve fallback compatibility
options.body: Keep legacy fallback for invalid explicit values and limit validation to malformed inputs or a separately opted-in strict mode.

options.title: Pause for API-contract discussion
options.body: Defer the PR until channel, Gateway, and CLI owners document the intended explicit-account compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict explicit routing
recommendation.body: Merge after refresh, treating every explicit account selection as authoritative and returning an error when it cannot resolve to an enabled account.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this contributor as the direct author of the complete proposed routing contract; repository owner history was not available in the supplied review context.
